retrievalProfile.description: Generates a 1970s-inspired soul or funk album cover featuring a central male figure in flamboyant patterned attire against a muted gradient, paired with heavy chrome-effect display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A waist-up studio portrait of a man with an afro, wearing a highly detailed, multi-patterned open shirt and a large ornate belt, positioned against a soft purple-to-grey gradient background with bold, 3D chrome-textured typography in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with hands on hips creating a triangular silhouette
Typography anchored to the top-left corner, overlapping the shoulder
High-contrast chrome text against a muted, desaturated background
Complex textile patterns contrasting with smooth skin and flat background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the heavy chrome title block in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the metallic title, moves down the subject's face and open chest, following the arms to the hands on the hips.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the head and shoulders, primarily in the upper right and left corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted lavender-grey background providing a neutral stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purples and browns in the clothing and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver/gold chrome in the typography and belt buckle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high detail and medium saturation in the central figure's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earthy tones and muted pastels

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
Hard drop shadows to separate from background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared or staggered to create a staircase effect in the title block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a smaller, italicized serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif skeleton needed for the 3D effect.
Strong geometric presence suitable for metallic treatments.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A waist-up studio portrait of a man with an afro, wearing an intricately patterned 70s-style open shirt and a large gold belt buckle, standing against a soft purple-grey gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 3D extruded chrome title in the top-left corner using a heavy slab-serif font, with smaller dark blue italicized text underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the main title 3D and chrome-textured?
Is the subject wearing a patterned open shirt?
Is the background a soft, desaturated gradient?
Is the layout a waist-up portrait?

mustAchieve: Convincing metallic chrome texture on text

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the main title
Ensure the shirt pattern is diverse and detailed
Verify the muted, vintage color palette
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 70s fashion portrait, add heavy 3D chrome typography in the corner, and apply a desaturated vintage film grain.
